prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target is a production map-icon atlas from an existing Japanese robot strategy game. Redraw every occupied icon as crisp HD anime mechanical miniatures with smooth anti-aliased ink outlines, fine armor lines, blue-purple and white armor, small green/yellow sensors matching the original palette. Strict UV atlas, not an illustration: 8 columns by 4 rows, every cell stays at identical exact location, each subject keeps its original pose, viewing angle, proportions, silhouette, extent and center. Each source icon occupies a 96x96 square centered within its 128x128 cell on a 1024x512 canvas; do not move, merge, omit, enlarge or rearrange any icon. Preserve numbers/letters that distinguish variants as small crisp marks in their source positions. Some icons are heads, others ships or vehicles; follow each reference faithfully. Keep the same 2:1 aspect ratio. Genuine zero-alpha transparent background outside each icon and in gaps. Clean opaque bodies, no shadow/glow/cloud/grunge, no labels, no divider lines, no extra subjects or decorations. Draw all 32 icons, including small equipment and tails, no pixelated edges.
